name: Ceres - Harvest Among The Stars
storyline:
Play as the spaceship’s farmer and keep your crew fed on the long journey to their new home.

Grow and enhance your garden carefully. Every decision matters and failing to produce enough food ends the journey.

To help you succeed, discover, plant, and grow completely unique space plants, like Rototor, Blihkki, Galady, and 30+ more!

But the journey isn’t easy: comets cross your path, bringing new, unpredictable challenges that can disrupt your food production each game.

Luckily, you’re not alone! Call on the 10 other crew members for help, including the Captain, Cook, and... Mycologist? Each have their own abilities to boost your harvest and keep your colony thriving!
summary: A cozy, turn-based farming game set aboard a colony spaceship. As the ship’s farmer, you grow and enhance plants with cards to feed a small crew and help your space colony thrive on its journey to your new destination, Ceres.
